title: Complete 3D kinematic parameters of the temporomandibular joints
creator: Gael Bescond
unit_verification: Article p.2 glossary explicitly states degrees for rotation and millimeters for translation. Workbook Glossary and columns identify frames; article abstract confirms normalized duration 1-100%.
method: Five healthy subjects; optical markers plus MRI-derived bone models. Published processed, smoothed, normalized motion parameters; not raw marker tracks.
limits: The Time column is normalized cycle percentage, not seconds. Playback rate is a display choice; velocity or acceleration in physical time cannot be recovered.
OVP rotations are the publication's orientation-vector convention, not verified XYZ Euler angles. Do not assign directly to a 3D engine's Euler rotation.
Keep each subject and each coordinate frame separate. Local left and right frame signs/orientations differ; do not mirror one side or interpret local coordinates as world coordinates.
No source-subject bone meshes, landmarks or transforms to the simulator head have been acquired. These trajectories cannot provide registered motion of that head or its disc/capsule.
Published manual/virtual landmark fusion median RMSE is 8.0 mm; this is not a submillimeter navigation calibration.
Rotations/translations have initial offsets. Raw coordinate, relative-to-first-sample displacement, and range of motion are different quantities.
The source includes no direct disc motion, tissue force, portal tracking or fluid measurements.
glossary_rows: In the Skull Global Frame: SGF
In the Right Skull Local Frame: RSLF
In the Left Skull Local Frame: LSLF
For the Instantaneous Helical Axis: IHA
